sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·朗森，欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 即使是在我还在夜店打碟的黑胶唱片时代，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 每晚你都要带着你最珍视的300件宝贝去工作，把DJ台变成一个充满活力的快闪博物馆，陈列着那些精美的、有50年历史的艺术品。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼出品的《重构者》吧。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Sabrina Tavernisi.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的萨布丽娜·塔弗尼西。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Last weekend, my colleague Anton Trainovsky called a woman who lives in a small town above the Arctic Circle in northern Russia.
sentences.zh: 上周末，我的同事安东·特拉诺夫斯基给一位住在俄罗斯北部北极圈内小镇的女士打了电话。

sentences.en: She told him she was in line at the pediatrician with sick kids when she first heard the news.
sentences.zh: 她告诉他，当时她正带着生病的孩子在儿科医生那里排队，就在那时她听到了这个消息。

sentences.en: The woman next to her got a phone call.
sentences.zh: 她旁边的一位女士接到了一个电话。

sentences.en: Someone's son had just been drafted to go fight the war in Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 有人刚被征召去乌克兰参加战争。

sentences.en: When she overheard that, she said, I felt like ice inside.
sentences.zh: 当她无意中听到这个消息时，她说：“我感觉内心如坠冰窟。”

sentences.en: Like some kind of darkness had fallen.
sentences.zh: 就像某种黑暗降临了一样。

sentences.en: Then she started hearing about other men.
sentences.zh: 然后她开始听到关于其他男人的消息。

sentences.en: Her husband's business got a letter.
sentences.zh: 她丈夫的公司收到了一封信。

sentences.en: Seven employees had to respond to the draft office.
sentences.zh: 七名员工必须去征兵办公室报到。

sentences.en: The band director at a local school got the call.
sentences.zh: 当地一所学校的乐队指挥也接到了电话。

sentences.en: Then the draft came for her extended family.
sentences.zh: 接着，征兵令波及到了她的远房亲戚。

sentences.en: They're taking my second cousin.
sentences.zh: 他们要带走我的堂弟。

sentences.en: They're taking my first cousin.
sentences.zh: 他们要带走我的表哥。

sentences.en: They're taking my nephew.
sentences.zh: 他们要带走我的侄子。

sentences.en: She's worried that, with winter coming, there won't be enough men to run the coal plant that heats people's homes.
sentences.zh: 她很担心，随着冬天临近，没有足够的男人来运营为居民供暖的燃煤电厂。

sentences.en: Or take care of the reindeer that her community depends on.
sentences.zh: 或者去照顾她所在的社区所依赖的驯鹿。

sentences.en: She said she doesn't understand the logic of taking so many people from a place where there are so few.
sentences.zh: 她说她不明白，在一个人口本就稀少的地方征召这么多人，逻辑何在。

sentences.en: The draft that Russian President Vladimir Putin announced a week ago is disrupting lives all over Russia.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京一周前宣布的征兵令正在扰乱整个俄罗斯的生活。

sentences.en: Russians describe getting draft notices while they're at home and at work.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯人描述说，他们在家里或工作中收到了征兵通知。

sentences.en: Notices are even being forced into the hands of those arrested for protesting the war.
sentences.zh: 甚至连那些因抗议战争而被捕的人，也被强行塞了通知书。

sentences.en: Today, I talked to one man facing conscription about how his life has changed since the day the war came to Russia.
sentences.zh: 今天，我采访了一位面临征兵的男子，谈谈自战争来到俄罗斯的那天起，他的生活发生了怎样的变化。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, September 29th.
sentences.zh: 今天是9月29日，星期四。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Tell me your name, your, just your first name, because I know the sensitivities, your age, and where you live.
sentences.zh: 告诉我你的名字，只说名字就行，因为我知道其中的敏感性，还有你的年龄以及你住在哪里。

sentences.en: Меня зовут Кирилл.
sentences.zh: 我的名字是基里尔。

sentences.en: Мне 24 года.
sentences.zh: 我今年24岁。

sentences.en: Я живу в Подмосковье.
sentences.zh: 我住在莫斯科州。

sentences.en: My name is Кирилл.
sentences.zh: 我的名字是基里尔。

sentences.en: I'm 24, and I live in Moscow, OblaSt.
sentences.zh: 我24岁，住在莫斯科州。

sentences.en: So, Кирилл, going back to the beginning of the war, when Putin first ordered the invasion of Ukraine on February 24th, take me back to that moment in your life.
sentences.zh: 那么，基里尔，回到战争刚开始的时候，当普京在2月24日首次下令入侵乌克兰时，带我回到你生命中的那一刻。

sentences.en: What did you think when you saw that?
sentences.zh: 当你看到那个消息时，你是怎么想的？

sentences.en: On the 24th, I woke up not very early, kind of like usual, around 11 o'clock in the morning.
sentences.zh: 24号那天，我醒得不算太早，和平常差不多，大概上午11点左右。

sentences.en: My friend in the morning said that war had begun.
sentences.zh: 我朋友早上告诉我战争开始了。

sentences.en: If I'm being honest with you,
sentences.zh: 如果我跟你说实话的话，

sentences.en: I don't actually remember that day very much because I didn't fully understand and comprehend the magnitude of what had happened and how horrible it would all be.
sentences.zh: 其实我那天记得不太清楚，因为我当时并没有完全理解和领会所发生之事的严重性，以及这一切会有多可怕。

sentences.en: I remember that I went home that day and began talking to my parents.
sentences.zh: 我记得那天我回家后开始和父母交谈。

sentences.en: I didn't really want to talk about it with my parents because I don't talk about political topics with them.
sentences.zh: 我其实不想和父母谈论这件事，因为我不和他们讨论政治话题。

sentences.en: We have very different points of view, and I like to avoid those things with them.
sentences.zh: 我们的观点差异很大，我喜欢在他们面前避开这些事情。

sentences.en: The year before, I had gone to a protest against Putin.
sentences.zh: 前一年，我参加过一次反普京的抗议活动。

sentences.en: I hadn't understood until that moment how different we were and how different we had become.
sentences.zh: 直到那一刻，我才明白我们之间有多么不同，我们已经变得多么疏远。

sentences.en: By the mere act of going to that protest, they saw me as someone who was against the policies of Putin, and that was true.
sentences.zh: 仅仅因为参加了那次抗议，他们就把我看作是一个反对普京政策的人，而事实确实如此。

sentences.en: — Kirill, did they support Putin?
sentences.zh: ——基里尔，他们支持普京吗？

sentences.en: What were their views about him?
sentences.zh: 他们对他有什么看法？

sentences.en: — So my parents didn't openly support Putin, but did believe what he was saying about the war.
sentences.zh: ——我父母并不公开支持普京，但他们相信他关于战争的说法。

sentences.en: — My parents aren't exactly part of that really toxic part of the public that's really, really for this war, that, you know, puts Z-stickers on the back of their car.
sentences.zh: ——我父母并不属于公众中那种极其激进、非常非常支持这场战争的部分，你知道，就是那种在车后贴Z字贴纸的人。

sentences.en: They're not those people.
sentences.zh: 他们不是那样的人。

sentences.en: — It's hard for me to quite describe to you, but I will say that they are people who try very hard not to notice.
sentences.zh: ——我很难向你准确描述，但我会说他们是那种极力试图不去注意的人。

sentences.en: — The lawlessness that is going on around them.
sentences.zh: ——不去注意他们周围正在发生的无法无天之事。

sentences.en: — And I came to them and said, the war is a catastrophe.
sentences.zh: ——我走到他们面前说，这场战争是一场灾难。

sentences.en: There's no reason in the world that one country should attack another country.
sentences.zh: 世界上没有任何理由让一个国家攻击另一个国家。

sentences.en: It just seemed so clear to me.
sentences.zh: 这对我来说似乎显而易见。

sentences.en: And they said, what do you mean by war?
sentences.zh: 他们却说，你说的战争是什么意思？

sentences.en: — Are you saying that they're lying to us and you're the one who knows the truth?
sentences.zh: ——你是说他们在对我们撒谎，而你是那个知道真相的人吗？

sentences.en: — Yeah.
sentences.zh: ——是的。

sentences.en: — Did you argue?
sentences.zh: ——你们吵架了吗？

sentences.en: — Yes, we argued very badly.
sentences.zh: ——是的，我们吵得很凶。

sentences.en: — I love my parents.
sentences.zh: ——我爱我的父母。

sentences.en: That's clear.
sentences.zh: 这一点很明确。

sentences.en: — We each set our position and never returned to the topic because we understood we just had different points of view.
sentences.zh: ——我们各自表明了立场，之后再也没有回到这个话题，因为我们明白我们只是观点不同。

sentences.en: — So the time started going by, yes.
sentences.zh: ——时间就这样一天天过去，是的。

sentences.en: And I basically turned into a person that was just constantly updating the news on my phone.
sentences.zh: 我基本上变成了一个不断在手机上刷新新闻的人。

sentences.en: — The strange thing was, there was a war.
sentences.zh: ——奇怪的是，战争确实发生了。

sentences.en: I could see it happening.
sentences.zh: 我能看到它正在发生。

sentences.en: But in the first three months, I didn't really feel it at all.
sentences.zh: 但在最初的三个月里，我一点也没感觉到。

sentences.en: — Nothing around me changed.
sentences.zh: ——我周围什么都没变。

sentences.en: — The first thing I noticed was that the prices really started going up in the stores.
sentences.zh: ——我注意到的第一件事是商店里的价格真的开始上涨了。

sentences.en: — I didn't have a very big salary, and I felt it a lot.
sentences.zh: ——我的工资不高，我感受很深。

sentences.en: The price of fruits, the price of vegetables were going up very sharply.
sentences.zh: 水果和蔬菜的价格涨得非常厉害。

sentences.en: — I was seeing that some of the factories were closing, and a lot of the Western firms were leaving Russia.
sentences.zh: ——我看到一些工厂倒闭了，许多西方公司也离开了俄罗斯。

sentences.en: — I was working in a company that was doing this cargo loading, and a lot of it was parts for airplanes.
sentences.zh: ——我当时在一家做货物装载的公司工作，其中很多是飞机零部件。

sentences.en: — And there were firings.
sentences.zh: ——然后就开始裁员了。

sentences.en: — A big portion of our colleagues were transferred to a, quote-unquote, leave without pay.
sentences.zh: ——我们很大一部分同事被转到了所谓的“无薪休假”。

sentences.en: They were continuing to be held on the books, but there was no money, and really, they were just all sitting at home without a job.
sentences.zh: 他们虽然还在名册上，但没有钱拿，实际上他们都失业在家。

sentences.en: — I worked for another two and a half months.
sentences.zh: ——我又工作了两个半月。

sentences.en: — I'd started volunteering at a non-profit that helped homeless people.
sentences.zh: ——我开始在一家帮助无家可归者的非营利组织做志愿者。

sentences.en: — And I heard that they actually had an opening for a paid position.
sentences.zh: ——我听说他们确实有一个带薪职位的空缺。

sentences.en: — I applied for the position and got it, and it was a slightly better paid, and it's the thing that's given me strength in these months.
sentences.zh: ——我申请了这个职位并得到了它，工资稍微好一点，这几个月来正是这份工作给了我力量。

sentences.en: — But if you talk about the quality of life, it didn't really change that much.
sentences.zh: ——但如果谈到生活质量，其实并没有太大变化。

sentences.en: — I was in horror looking at this, but there was really nothing radical at all, nothing much changed.
sentences.zh: ——我看着这一切感到恐惧，但真的没有什么激进的变化，一切都没怎么变。

sentences.en: — And that is what was most disturbing for me, the contraSt.
sentences.zh: ——而这正是最让我不安的地方，这种反差。

sentences.en: — A number of years ago, a very famous rock musician said this about the Chechen War.
sentences.zh: ——几年前，一位非常有名的摇滚音乐家在谈到车臣战争时说过这样的话。

sentences.en: — He said the most disturbing thing was being at the war and seeing the mud and the death,
sentences.zh: ——他说最令人不安的是身处战争之中，看到泥泞和死亡，

sentences.en: and getting on an airplane and flying back and landing in Moscow and seeing people walking around on the streets and children playing on jungle gyms and people shopping.
sentences.zh: 然后坐上飞机飞回莫斯科，降落后看到人们在街上走来走去，孩子们在攀爬架上玩耍，人们在购物。

sentences.en: — The most frightening thing is for people to have their lives keep going on and not feel the pain that is being caused in this other place.
sentences.zh: ——最可怕的是人们的生活继续进行，却感受不到在另一个地方所造成的痛苦。

sentences.en: It really just didn't concern our lives.
sentences.zh: 这真的与我们的生活无关。

sentences.en: Were you ever worried that the war would come to you?
sentences.zh: 你有没有担心过战争会波及到你？

sentences.en: — In the most direct sense, no.
sentences.zh: ——从最直接的意义上讲，没有。

sentences.en: — If it was going to affect us, the war, it would really only be kind of tangentially sort of on the sidelines,
sentences.zh: ——如果战争要影响我们，那也只是边缘性的、间接的影响，

sentences.en: you know, that the prices had risen and my father was having problems at work because of the war.
sentences.zh: 你知道，物价上涨了，我父亲因为战争在工作中遇到了问题。

sentences.en: What were the problems your father was having because of the war?
sentences.zh: 你父亲因为战争遇到了什么问题？

sentences.en: — My father repairs and sells imported equipment for the milking of cows, and the sanctions really hit that.
sentences.zh: ——我父亲修理和销售进口的挤奶设备，制裁确实打击了这一块。

sentences.en: — It was a firm that worked in Russia, and it left.
sentences.zh: ——那是一家在俄罗斯运营的公司，它撤走了。

sentences.en: — How did that affect your father's point of view about the war?
sentences.zh: ——这如何影响了你父亲对战争的看法？

sentences.en: — Not at all.
sentences.zh: ——完全没有。

sentences.en: — He kept repeating that it was much worse in the 1990s, so we'll be fine.
sentences.zh: ——他一直重复说90年代比现在糟糕得多，所以我们会没事的。

sentences.en: We'll survive.
sentences.zh: 我们会活下去的。

sentences.en: — What did you think of that?
sentences.zh: ——你对此怎么看？

sentences.en: — I was really sad.
sentences.zh: ——我真的很伤心。

sentences.en: — Because I just didn't understand that logic.
sentences.zh: ——因为我就是不理解那种逻辑。

sentences.en: — I wanted to live in a better way and not constantly be comparing ourselves to a worse way.
sentences.zh: ——我想过更好的生活，而不是不断地拿自己和更糟糕的情况做比较。

sentences.en: — Where were you the moment that you heard about this so-called partial mobilization?
sentences.zh: ——当你听到所谓的“部分动员”时，你在哪里？

sentences.en: — It was two days ago, I woke up 15 minutes before my alarm clock, and I saw the news.
sentences.zh: ——那是两天前，我在闹钟响前15分钟醒来，看到了新闻。

sentences.en: — I saw the news in the face of the president.
sentences.zh: ——我看到了总统那张脸上的新闻。

sentences.en: — I saw the banner headline with little lightning bolts next to it that was telling me this was important, that he was announcing a partial mobilization.
sentences.zh: ——我看到了标题，旁边还有小闪电，告诉我这很重要，他正在宣布部分动员。

sentences.en: — And I understood that, given my health, my age, and my former military service, that I fit the criteria 100 percent.
sentences.zh: ——我明白，考虑到我的健康状况、年龄和曾经的服役经历，我百分之百符合条件。

sentences.en: How did you feel in that moment?
sentences.zh: 那一刻你感觉如何？

sentences.en: — I guess I just felt this sense of resignation, kind of futility.
sentences.zh: ——我想我只感到一种听天由命，一种徒劳感。

sentences.en: Like, I was just going to go to work, but I was going to be called up in this draft and go to war.
sentences.zh: 就像，我本来打算去上班，但我会被征召入伍去打仗。

sentences.en: — What was the feeling in your heart?
sentences.zh: ——你心里是什么感觉？

sentences.en: — None.
sentences.zh: ——什么都没有。

sentences.en: — I felt this emptiness, not anger, kind of almost nothing.
sentences.zh: ——我感到一种空虚，不是愤怒，几乎什么都没有。

sentences.en: — I just thought, what do I do next?
sentences.zh: ——我只是想，接下来我该怎么办？

sentences.en: — Because I realized at that moment that the war had finally come to me.
sentences.zh: ——因为那一刻我意识到，战争终于降临到我头上了。

sentences.en: — We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: ——我们马上回来。

sentences.en: — Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: ——你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《Dealbook》报道商业和政策。

sentences.en: — On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: ——11月18日，我将在纽约市的Dealbook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的人物，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼等等。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无保留、未经剪辑的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将于11月18日在nytimes.com上直播部分采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download The New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序观看，并获得一个月的免费访问权限，阅读我们所有的报道。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你不会想错过的。

sentences.en: — Kirill, you talked about your military service.
sentences.zh: ——基里尔，你谈到了你的服役经历。

sentences.en: How long did you serve in the military?
sentences.zh: 你在军队服役了多久？

sentences.en: — I was there for a year.
sentences.zh: ——我在那里待了一年。

sentences.en: — I tried to maximally escape any mandatory military service.
sentences.zh: ——我曾试图最大限度地逃避任何强制兵役。

sentences.en: — I didn't get into a university.
sentences.zh: ——我没考上大学。

sentences.en: I got into a technical school.
sentences.zh: 我进了一所技术学校。

sentences.en: But when I graduated from my technical school, I was drafted, and I didn't have money to buy my way out of it.
sentences.zh: 但当我从技术学校毕业时，我被征召了，我没有钱买通关系逃避兵役。

sentences.en: — The only people who really go to the army are the ones that can't buy their way out of it.
sentences.zh: ——真正去参军的人都是那些没钱买通关系的人。

sentences.en: — I'm looking at a lot of the videos about the Russian soldiers who were captured in Ukraine, the Russian prisoners of war.
sentences.zh: ——我看了很多关于在乌克兰被俘的俄罗斯士兵、俄罗斯战俘的视频。

sentences.en: And I tell you, eight out of ten of them say that they just went because it was the path of least resistance.
sentences.zh: 我告诉你，他们中十个人里有八个说他们去参军只是因为那是阻力最小的路径。

sentences.en: They didn't have the money to buy their way out.
sentences.zh: 他们没有钱买通关系逃避。

sentences.en: And they didn't want to go to prison for 10 years.
sentences.zh: 他们也不想因为逃兵役去坐10年牢。

sentences.en: So they chose this.
sentences.zh: 所以他们选择了这条路。

sentences.en: — It's not a choice to go off to defend the fatherland.
sentences.zh: ——去保卫祖国并不是一种选择。

sentences.en: It's about poverty and the desire to feed their families.
sentences.zh: 这关乎贫困和养家糊口的渴望。

sentences.en: So going back to when Putin first announced the mobilization, what did you start to do?
sentences.zh: 回到普京首次宣布动员的时候，你开始做什么了？

sentences.en: What was the first thing?
sentences.zh: 第一件事是什么？

sentences.en: — First, I started researching where I could go to get out.
sentences.zh: ——首先，我开始研究我能去哪里逃离。

sentences.en: Where I could go to get out that wouldn't require a visa and wouldn't require a lot of money, because I don't have a lot of money.
sentences.zh: 去哪里不需要签证，也不需要很多钱，因为我没有多少钱。

sentences.en: — Physically, I started to feel bad.
sentences.zh: ——身体上，我开始感觉不舒服。

sentences.en: I had a really bad headache.
sentences.zh: 我头痛得厉害。

sentences.en: — I was very afraid.
sentences.zh: — 我当时非常害怕。

sentences.en: I'm not going to hide it from you.
sentences.zh: 我不会瞒着你。

sentences.en: I was terrified.
sentences.zh: 我吓坏了。

sentences.en: — Then I just sat down, breathed in, caught my breath, and I went to work.
sentences.zh: — 后来我只是坐下来，深呼吸，平复了一下心情，然后开始工作。

sentences.en: — I got there, and there were several other young men who were in the same category as me.
sentences.zh: — 我到了那里，还有其他几个和我情况一样的年轻人。

sentences.en: — We sat there, and we were drinking coffee together and kind of laughing and just talking about it, and it felt better.
sentences.zh: — 我们坐在那儿，一起喝咖啡，聊着聊着笑了起来，感觉好多了。

sentences.en: — We were talking about what was the information out there, who was going to try to leave, what we were going to try to do.
sentences.zh: — 我们在讨论外界的消息，谁打算离开，我们打算怎么做。

sentences.en: What were they saying?
sentences.zh: 他们当时在说什么？

sentences.en: — We were just trying to find the logic in a very illogical decision.
sentences.zh: — 我们只是试图在一个非常不合逻辑的决定中寻找逻辑。

sentences.en: — As the hours went by and I was texting with my friends and watching the news, it became very clear how many lies had been told.
sentences.zh: — 随着时间流逝，我一边和朋友发短信，一边看新闻，很明显，他们撒了多少谎。

sentences.en: — They said they wouldn't draft students, and we saw many students being called up.
sentences.zh: — 他们说不会征召学生，但我们看到很多学生被征召了。

sentences.en: — They said they wouldn't draft people who were in their 50s and 60s, and we saw many people in their 50s and 60s being called up.
sentences.zh: — 他们说不会征召五六十岁的人，但我们看到很多五六十岁的人被征召了。

sentences.en: So it became clear that this was something that was really going to affect everybody.
sentences.zh: 所以很明显，这件事真的会影响到每一个人。

sentences.en: — Then I began to feel really in danger that they're going to come for me right now.
sentences.zh: — 然后我开始感到非常危险，觉得他们随时会来抓我。

sentences.en: — And I saw, when the news had been announced about a partial mobilization, all of these people going out to proteSt.
sentences.zh: — 当部分动员令的消息宣布时，我看到所有这些人走上街头抗议。

sentences.en: — I wanted to go out to the protest, and it's clear that in Russia, of course, the protests don't influence or affect anything.
sentences.zh: — 我想去参加抗议，但很显然，在俄罗斯，抗议当然起不到任何作用，也影响不了什么。

sentences.en: — But it was really the only true and honest thing I could have done at that moment.
sentences.zh: — 但那确实是我当时唯一能做的真实而诚实的事情。

sentences.en: — But I stayed home because I was very afraid that if they got me, if the police got me, that would lead to my drafting.
sentences.zh: — 可我还是待在家里，因为我非常害怕，如果我被抓了，如果警察抓到我，那我就肯定会被征召入伍了。

sentences.en: How do you feel about that?
sentences.zh: 你对此有什么感觉？

sentences.en: — I feel regret that I didn't go.
sentences.zh: — 我很后悔没去。

sentences.en: — I feel that it was wrong that I didn't go.
sentences.zh: — 我觉得没去是错的。

sentences.en: — I don't know.
sentences.zh: — 我不知道。

sentences.en: — Why do you think it was wrong not to go to the protest?
sentences.zh: — 你为什么觉得没去参加抗议是错的？

sentences.en: — Because I understood that I was just hiding behind the backs of other people.
sentences.zh: — 因为我明白，我只是躲在别人身后。

sentences.en: — It was as if I had just kind of abandoned the mission, as if I was saying,
sentences.zh: — 就好像我放弃了任务，就好像我在说，

sentences.en: OK, young women, young men, you people not of drafting age, you go out and say your piece and say it on my behalf.
sentences.zh: 好吧，年轻的姑娘们，年轻的小伙子们，你们这些还没到征召年龄的人，你们去表达你们的诉求，替我发声吧。

sentences.en: — Ah, these people will be receiving bruises and wounds.
sentences.zh: — 啊，这些人会挨打受伤。

sentences.en: — But I think in retrospect, to sit at home and do nothing is actually harder than that.
sentences.zh: — 但回想起来，我觉得坐在家里什么都不做，其实比那更难受。

sentences.en: — I feel like I'm dramatizing this.
sentences.zh: — 我觉得我有点太戏剧化了。

sentences.en: I don't want to be dramatizing this.
sentences.zh: 我不想把这件事搞得太戏剧化。

sentences.en: — — No, no, no, no, no.
sentences.zh: — — 不，不，不，不，不。

sentences.en: I don't want you to be thinking that I'm in some sort of terrible situation.
sentences.zh: 我不想让你觉得我处在某种可怕的境地中。

sentences.en: It's just a lot of people are in this situation now.
sentences.zh: 只是现在很多人都处在这种境地里。

sentences.en: — I'm warm.
sentences.zh: — 我很温暖。

sentences.en: I feel good.
sentences.zh: 我感觉很好。

sentences.en: I'm under a roof.
sentences.zh: 我有遮风挡雨的地方。

sentences.en: — The thing that I'm feeling right now has nothing, nothing in comparison to the thing that people are feeling who are in the war.
sentences.zh: — 我现在的感受，和那些身处战争中的人们的感受相比，根本算不了什么。

sentences.en: — I don't want to have any comparison drawn there.
sentences.zh: — 我不想做任何比较。

sentences.en: — So, two days after Putin's announcement, my father got a call.
sentences.zh: — 普京宣布动员令两天后，我父亲接到了一个电话。

sentences.en: — A friend of his in the police station gave him a call.
sentences.zh: — 他在警察局的一个朋友给他打的电话。

sentences.en: — And he said, there's a draft notice for your son tomorrow, for the next day.
sentences.zh: — 那人说，明天或者后天会给你儿子发征兵通知。

sentences.en: — And that he was going to bring it over.
sentences.zh: — 而且他打算亲自送过来。

sentences.en: — I had this feeling of helplessness.
sentences.zh: — 我当时感到一种无助感。

sentences.en: I didn't know what to do.
sentences.zh: 我不知道该怎么办。

sentences.en: — And I've been at work for the past couple of days.
sentences.zh: — 这几天我一直待在工作的地方。

sentences.en: You live at work now?
sentences.zh: 你现在住在单位？

sentences.en: — Yes, I'm living at work.
sentences.zh: — 是的，我住在单位。

sentences.en: — You're sleeping there?
sentences.zh: — 你睡在那儿？

sentences.en: You're brushing your teeth there?
sentences.zh: 你在那儿刷牙？

sentences.en: You're taking a shower there?
sentences.zh: 你在那儿洗澡？

sentences.en: — Yeah, actually, all of the above.
sentences.zh: — 是的，其实以上这些都在这儿做。

sentences.en: And it's actually not that hard because I'm working in an organization that is for homeless people.
sentences.zh: 而且其实并不难，因为我工作的机构是为无家可归者服务的。

sentences.en: So there's lots of creature comforts and things that we have for people around.
sentences.zh: 所以我们有很多为人们准备的舒适生活用品。

sentences.en: — I'm hiding here because I don't want to be in a place where people recognize me and people could come and give me this draft notice.
sentences.zh: — 我躲在这里，因为我不想去那种会被人认出来、被人送来征兵通知的地方。

sentences.en: — The way that it has been working is that people are being given these things on the streets, at protests, when they come out of the metro.
sentences.zh: — 他们现在的做法是，在街上、在抗议活动中，或者人们从地铁出来时，直接把这些东西发给他们。

sentences.en: — And this is something that I'm trying to avoid.
sentences.zh: — 这就是我试图避免的事情。

sentences.en: So I've been here at work, and I don't think they will find me or get me if I don't go out.
sentences.zh: 所以我一直待在单位，只要我不出去，我想他们就找不到我，也抓不到我。

sentences.en: — There were a few people in my company that met the criteria for the draft.
sentences.zh: — 我公司里有几个人符合征召条件。

sentences.en: — We put a few plans together, which we're now trying to carry out.
sentences.zh: — 我们制定了一些计划，现在正试图实施。

sentences.en: — Our co-workers are trying to gather all of our documents and figure out from embassies and from different places where potentially we could go and get a visa to get out.
sentences.zh: — 同事们正在努力收集我们所有的文件，并从大使馆和其他地方打听我们可能去哪里申请签证离开。

sentences.en: — I'm hugely grateful to them, but I understand that that variant is really unlikely, that it's basically not going to happen.
sentences.zh: — 我非常感激他们，但我明白那个方案不太可能实现，基本上是不可能的。

sentences.en: — — So if that doesn't happen, and I don't think it will, then the second thing we're thinking of is to get to the border with Kazakhstan.
sentences.zh: — — 所以如果那个行不通，而且我觉得也行不通，那么我们考虑的第二个方案就是去哈萨克斯坦边境。

sentences.en: And we're hoping that the border doesn't close.
sentences.zh: 我们希望边境不会关闭。

sentences.en: When would you go to Kazakhstan?
sentences.zh: 你打算什么时候去哈萨克斯坦？

sentences.en: — So I'll probably be in this workspace that I've been in for the past couple of days until the 28th of September.
sentences.zh: — 我大概会一直待在这个我待了几天的工作场所，直到9月28日。

sentences.en: — But if I get a visa, there's still a danger, because they're looking for people in the airports, and they could be looking at my passport in the airport.
sentences.zh: — 但如果我拿到了签证，仍然有危险，因为他们在机场搜查人员，他们可能会在机场检查我的护照。

sentences.en: So airports are not a safe place.
sentences.zh: 所以机场不是安全的地方。

sentences.en: — In the train stations, they're checking people even less, and the least of all, the checking, is by car.
sentences.zh: — 在火车站，他们检查得少一些，而开车的话，检查是最少的。

sentences.en: — Do you plan to go by car?
sentences.zh: — 你打算开车去吗？

sentences.en: — Probably, yes.
sentences.zh: — 大概是吧。

sentences.en: — Сколько часов ездли, Кирилл?
sentences.zh: — 基里尔，要开几个小时？

sentences.en: Не знаешь?
sentences.zh: 你不知道吗？

sentences.en: How far is it to the Kazakh border?
sentences.zh: 到哈萨克斯坦边境有多远？

sentences.en: — Right now I'm looking, I'm looking.
sentences.zh: — 我现在正在查，正在查。

sentences.en: It's about a 20-hour drive.
sentences.zh: 开车大约要20个小时。

sentences.en: — That's very far.
sentences.zh: — 那太远了。

sentences.en: — But again, there's a complication.
sentences.zh: — 但话说回来，还有一个困难。

sentences.en: — I don't have a car, so this would mean maybe finding a group that was going or asking someone to drive me to the border.
sentences.zh: — 我没有车，这意味着我可能得找个顺路的团队，或者求人开车送我到边境。

sentences.en: — So far, I don't have any options here for me, but there are some options here.
sentences.zh: — 到目前为止，我还没什么选择，但这里确实有一些选项。

sentences.en: — My father.
sentences.zh: — 我父亲。

sentences.en: — My father has a car.
sentences.zh: — 我父亲有车。

sentences.en: — Maybe with him.
sentences.zh: — 也许可以跟他一起。

sentences.en: — Kirill, would you ask your father?
sentences.zh: — 基里尔，你会问你父亲吗？

sentences.en: — Would you ask your father to drive you to the border?
sentences.zh: — 你会请求你父亲开车送你去边境吗？

sentences.en: — I ask them to come see me on the weekend.
sentences.zh: — 我让他们周末来看我。

sentences.en: It's probably going to be on Sunday.
sentences.zh: 大概会在周日。

sentences.en: And I'm going to personally ask if they would be amenable to that option.
sentences.zh: 我会亲自问他们是否愿意接受这个方案。

sentences.en: — They're having a hard time understanding the risks.
sentences.zh: — 他们很难理解其中的风险。

sentences.en: They see only what is told on television, which is that young people won't be sent to the war.
sentences.zh: 他们只看电视上说的，说年轻人不会被派去打仗。

sentences.en: They'll first get some training.
sentences.zh: 他们会先接受一些训练。

sentences.en: So it's hard for me to explain that I risk prison time and that I'm not going to go to this draft.
sentences.zh: 所以我很难向他们解释，我面临着坐牢的风险，而且我绝不会去应征。

sentences.en: — What will you say to them?
sentences.zh: — 你会跟他们说什么？

sentences.en: — I'll tell them that I don't want to die purely for the reason of one person who's doing this completely senseless thing.
sentences.zh: — 我会告诉他们，我不想仅仅为了一个正在做这种完全毫无意义之事的个人而死。

sentences.en: — I'll just explain in a very practical way, and I hope that we can find a common language.
sentences.zh: — 我会用非常实际的方式解释，希望我们能达成共识。

sentences.en: — Yeah, because for them, I believe that I'm more valuable than the military principles.
sentences.zh: — 是的，因为我相信在他们眼里，我比那些军事原则更重要。

sentences.en: — I think for them, I'm more valuable than some type of abstract idea about the war or victory.
sentences.zh: — 我想在他们眼里，我比某种关于战争或胜利的抽象概念更重要。

sentences.en: They love you.
sentences.zh: 他们爱你。

sentences.en: — What do you think that they'll say back to you?
sentences.zh: — 你觉得他们会怎么回答你？

sentences.en: — They'll probably be translating all of the things that they're hearing on television, that this won't really concern you, it won't reach you, it'll be okay.
sentences.zh: — 他们可能会复述他们在电视上听到的所有话，说这事儿不会真的影响到你，不会波及到你，会没事的。

sentences.en: Maybe we should just go out to the country for a while.
sentences.zh: 也许我们应该去乡下待一段时间。

sentences.en: — I'll just be coming from how I see the situation, and I'll ask them for help.
sentences.zh: — 我会从我所看到的局势出发，请求他们的帮助。

sentences.en: And if they refuse, then I'm going to find a way to get to the border.
sentences.zh: 如果他们拒绝，那我就自己想办法去边境。

sentences.en: — Kirill, if your parents do refuse, or simply say back what they're seeing on television, is that painful to you?
sentences.zh: — 基里尔，如果你的父母真的拒绝了，或者只是复述他们在电视上看到的东西，你会感到痛苦吗？

sentences.en: That you might not be able to find a common language, even when it's about your own life?
sentences.zh: 即使是关于你自己的生命，你们也可能无法达成共识？

sentences.en: — No, it's not painful.
sentences.zh: — 不，不痛苦。

sentences.en: — If I had also been steeped in the propaganda for so many years, that we have external enemies, that we need to be vigilant, I think I would probably have the same view.
sentences.zh: — 如果我也被灌输了这么多年的宣传，说我们有外部敌人，我们需要保持警惕，我想我可能也会有同样的看法。

sentences.en: — If you don't make it to Kazakhstan, what will happen?
sentences.zh: — 如果你没能到达哈萨克斯坦，会发生什么？

sentences.en: — Well, it depends on if they stop me.
sentences.zh: — 嗯，这取决于他们是否拦住我。

sentences.en: — If that happens, then I'm going to have to hide somewhere inside the borders of Russia.
sentences.zh: — 如果发生了那种情况，那我就得躲在俄罗斯境内的某个地方。

sentences.en: — Kirill, when you think about going to war on behalf of Russia, wearing a Russian uniform in Ukraine,
sentences.zh: — 基里尔，当你想到要代表俄罗斯去打仗，在乌克兰穿上俄罗斯军装时，

sentences.en: — when you think about having to do that, how does that make you feel?
sentences.zh: — 当你想到必须那样做时，你有什么感觉？

sentences.en: — That's the most terrifying thought of all.
sentences.zh: — 那是最可怕的想法。

sentences.en: — I've already decided that it's better to go to jail than to go off to that absolutely insane and senseless war.
sentences.zh: — 我已经决定了，宁可坐牢，也不去参加那场绝对疯狂且毫无意义的战争。

sentences.en: — Why is it such a terrifying thought for you, being in Ukraine in a Russian uniform?
sentences.zh: — 为什么身穿俄罗斯军装在乌克兰对你来说是一个如此可怕的想法？

sentences.en: — It's not even about the fear of being killed, but of killing someone.
sentences.zh: — 这甚至不是关于害怕被杀，而是关于杀人。

sentences.en: — It's horror.
sentences.zh: — 那是恐怖。

sentences.en: — Cocktail.
sentences.zh: — 鸡尾酒。

sentences.en: — I said, how are you doing?
sentences.zh: — 我说，你最近怎么样？

sentences.en: — He said, I'm okay, I just didn't sleep very much, and I'm not thinking very well right now.
sentences.zh: — 他说，我还好，只是没怎么睡，现在脑子不太清醒。

sentences.en: — Oh my goodness, Kirill.
sentences.zh: — 天哪，基里尔。

sentences.en: — I had these plans, I had plans for a vacation, I had plans to read, I had plans for the next couple of weeks,
sentences.zh: — 我本来有计划，我有度假计划，有阅读计划，有接下来几周的计划，

sentences.en: and now I'm just constantly obsessively watching the news and trying to figure out how to get to the Kazakh border.
sentences.zh: 而现在我只是不停地、强迫性地看新闻，试图弄清楚怎么去哈萨克斯坦边境。

sentences.en: — Strange that I had these plans.
sentences.zh: — 真奇怪，我竟然还有过那些计划。

sentences.en: — It's a very strange feeling, kind of a funny feeling almost for me now, because I feel at home here, and I feel happy here in this job.
sentences.zh: — 这是一种非常奇怪的感觉，对我来说几乎是一种滑稽的感觉，因为我在这里有家的感觉，在这份工作中感到快乐。

sentences.en: I myself am not very outgoing, and they've really made friends with me, and I want to stay.
sentences.zh: 我本人不太外向，但他们真的和我成了朋友，我想留下来。

sentences.en: — I can't really describe it.
sentences.zh: — 我真的无法描述。

sentences.en: — I can just concentrate on the one thing I know, that I have to leave this place, and that I have to leave the closest people to me in my life.
sentences.zh: — 我只能专注于我知道的一件事，那就是我必须离开这个地方，必须离开我生命中最亲近的人。

sentences.en: — But it feels like it's just going to be a long weekend, that I'm going to go away,
sentences.zh: — 但感觉就像这只是一个漫长的周末，我要出门一趟，

sentences.en: and that I'm going to come back, and I'll be right back here at the homeless shelter, talking with the residents.
sentences.zh: 然后我还会回来，回到这个收容所，和住户们聊天。

sentences.en: — Two days after our conversation, Kirill texts me.
sentences.zh: — 我们谈话两天后，基里尔给我发了短信。

sentences.en: He says he's heard the borders might be closing soon, and he needs to leave now.
sentences.zh: 他说听说边境可能很快就会关闭，他必须马上离开。

sentences.en: So he packs a small bag, his flashlight, his headphones, his favorite T-shirts.
sentences.zh: 于是他收拾了一个小包，带上手电筒、耳机和他最喜欢的T恤。

sentences.en: — He buys some Snickers and some bottles of water for the road.
sentences.zh: — 他买了一些士力架和几瓶水带在路上吃。

sentences.en: — His father can't drive him, so Kirill decides to take the bus with a friend.
sentences.zh: — 他父亲没法送他，所以基里尔决定和朋友一起坐大巴。

sentences.en: They ride through the night.
sentences.zh: 他们连夜赶路。

sentences.en: When they reach the border with Kazakhstan, they find a line of cars waiting to cross that stretches for 10 kilometers.
sentences.zh: 当他们到达哈萨克斯坦边境时，发现排队过境的车辆长达10公里。

sentences.en: So Kirill and his friend find a checkpoint where they can cross on foot.
sentences.zh: 于是基里尔和他的朋友找到了一个可以步行过境的检查站。

sentences.en: He texts me a picture of the crowd.
sentences.zh: 他给我发了一张人群的照片。

sentences.en: Thousands of people are waiting.
sentences.zh: 成千上万的人在等待。

sentences.en: Many of them are young men in sweatshirts, their hoods drawn against the cold.
sentences.zh: 他们中许多是穿着运动衫的年轻人，为了御寒戴着兜帽。

sentences.en: — He records a video of a border guard taunting the crowd, insulting them for trying to leave Russia.
sentences.zh: — 他录了一段视频，视频里边防警卫在嘲讽人群，侮辱他们试图离开俄罗斯。

sentences.en: — And then he stops texting.
sentences.zh: — 然后他就不再发短信了。

sentences.en: — For almost 20 hours, I don't hear anything.
sentences.zh: — 将近20个小时，我没有任何消息。

sentences.en: — Then, on Wednesday night, I get a message.
sentences.zh: — 然后，在周三晚上，我收到了一条消息。

sentences.en: — Sabrina, hello.
sentences.zh: — 萨布丽娜，你好。

sentences.en: — Everything is good.
sentences.zh: — 一切都好。

sentences.en: — I cross the border.
sentences.zh: — 我过境了。

sentences.en: — A few of the guys who were with me were not allowed to leave.
sentences.zh: — 和我一起的几个人没被允许离开。

sentences.en: — I so far don't have a local phone.
sentences.zh: — 我目前还没有当地的电话号码。

sentences.en: — Almost no internet.
sentences.zh: — 几乎没有网络。

sentences.en: — And for now, I'm answering only my loved ones and my friends.
sentences.zh: — 目前，我只回复亲人和朋友的消息。

sentences.en: — Since Putin announced the draft a week ago, an estimated 200,000 Russians have fled the country.
sentences.zh: — 自普京一周前宣布征兵以来，估计已有20万俄罗斯人逃离该国。

sentences.en: — We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: — 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: — The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: — 《纽约时报》的应用程序？

sentences.en: — Unlocked?
sentences.zh: — 解锁了吗？

sentences.en: — Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: — 大家都知道，你需要订阅《纽约时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: — But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: — 但如果能免费试用《纽约时报》一个月，且无需绑定信用卡呢？

sentences.en: — Now you can.
sentences.zh: — 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: — When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: — 首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序，即可免费使用第一个月。

sentences.en: — A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: — 用一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《纽约时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: — If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: — 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《纽约时报》应用程序，获取30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: — Here's what else you should know today.
sentences.zh: — 以下是你今天还应该了解的消息。

sentences.en: — I am in Key West, Florida.
sentences.zh: — 我现在在佛罗里达州的基韦斯特。

sentences.en: I am at the intersection of Eisenhower Drive and Truman Avenue, which you can tell from the roaring sounds of waves is now underwater.
sentences.zh: 我位于艾森豪威尔大道和杜鲁门大道的交叉口，从咆哮的浪声中你可以听出，这里现在已经被淹没在水下了。

sentences.en: — Hurricane Ian made landfall over Florida on Wednesday as a severe Category 4 storm.
sentences.zh: — 周三，飓风“伊恩”以四级强飓风的强度在佛罗里达州登陆。

sentences.en: It unleashed 150-mile-per-hour winds and 12-foot storm surges that submerged cars, knocked over houses, and left more than one million residents without power,
sentences.zh: 它带来了时速150英里的狂风和12英尺的风暴潮，淹没了汽车，冲倒了房屋，并导致超过一百万居民断电，

sentences.en: from Fort Myers to Key West, where my colleague Frances Robles documented the flooding.
sentences.zh: 从迈尔斯堡一直到基韦斯特，我的同事弗朗西斯·罗伯斯记录下了那里的洪水情况。

sentences.en: — It's interesting because this area was actually dry an hour or two hours ago when I came out earlier.
sentences.zh: — 这很有意思，因为我早些时候出来时，这个区域其实还是干的，就在一两个小时前。

sentences.en: And the authorities keep saying that even though Hurricane Ian passed during the night, that the worst of the storm surge was going to come afterwards,
sentences.zh: 当局一直说，尽管飓风“伊恩”在夜间过境，但最严重风暴潮会在之后到来，

sentences.en: that it was going to come today, that it's going to come tomorrow, maybe even Friday.
sentences.zh: 说它会在今天到来，明天到来，甚至可能是周五。

sentences.en: And lo and behold, exactly what they said was going to happen is what happened.
sentences.zh: 果不其然，他们所说的情况真的发生了。

sentences.en: — The greatest damage seemed to occur on Florida's southwest coast, off the Gulf of Mexico, where videos showed entire neighborhoods underwater.
sentences.zh: — 最严重的破坏似乎发生在佛罗里达州墨西哥湾沿岸的西南部，视频显示整个社区都被淹没在水下。

sentences.en: — Now, it is our meteorologists' view that the storm surge has likely peaked and will likely, you know, be less in the coming hours than it has been up to this point.
sentences.zh: — 现在，我们的气象学家认为风暴潮可能已经达到顶峰，你知道的，在接下来的几个小时里，它可能会比之前有所减弱。

sentences.en: — During a news conference, Florida Governor Ron DeSantis said that the worst appeared to be over,
sentences.zh: — 在新闻发布会上，佛罗里达州州长罗恩·德桑蒂斯表示，最糟糕的情况似乎已经过去，

sentences.en: but that Ian would still go down as one of the strongest hurricanes to ever hit the state.
sentences.zh: 但“伊恩”仍将作为袭击该州的最强飓风之一载入史册。

sentences.en: — But the fact is, there's going to be damage throughout the whole state, and people in other parts of the state be prepared for some impacts.
sentences.zh: — 但事实是，整个州都会受到破坏，州内其他地区的人们也要为可能受到的影响做好准备。

sentences.en: — The storm is now expected to move north and inland to cities like Orlando.
sentences.zh: — 该风暴目前预计将向北移动，深入奥兰多等内陆城市。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Lindsay Garrison and Will Reed.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由琳赛·加里森和威尔·里德制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Michael Benoit, contains original music by Alicia Bietube, Dan Powell, and Marion Lozano, and was engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 由迈克尔·伯努瓦剪辑，包含艾丽西亚·比图布、丹·鲍威尔和马里昂·洛扎诺的原创音乐，并由克里斯·伍德进行工程处理。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Landsverk of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由Wonderly的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰兹维克创作。

sentences.en: Special thanks to Valerie Hopkins and Anton Trinowski.
sentences.zh: 特别感谢瓦莱丽·霍普金斯和安东·特里诺夫斯基。

sentences.en: — That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: — 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Sabrina Tavernisi.
sentences.zh: 我是萨布丽娜·塔弗尼西。

sentences.en: We'll see you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我们明天见。

sentences.en: — This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: — 本周的《Wirecutter秀》节目，我们将为假期接待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人宾至如归的小贴士。

sentences.en: — Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: — 他们需要全黑的睡眠环境吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会因为喝醉而睡着。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require, because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 我是指他们对光线有什么要求，因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: — Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: — 他们有过敏或食物不耐受的情况吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: — Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app, or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: — 在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢的任何播客平台上收听《Wirecutter秀》。
